name: Charles Gornowich
career_history: Senior Preconstruction Manager at T5 Data Centers, 11/2025 to present; Preconstruction Manager at T5 Data Centers, 9/2024 to present; Director of Construction Management at SWSG, 2/1999 to 3/2024; Director of Construction Management at SWSG, 5/1998 to 5/2024; Purchasing Agent at Rocky Gorge Communities, 1/1991 to 5/1999
education: Architecture and Engineering, Northern Virginia Community College, 1982 to 1985
biography: Charles is a Construction Professional with over 30 years of experience in the construction industry including commercial, light industrial, telecommunications, data centers as well as public/quasi-public governmental projects. His thirty years in this business has taught him it is imperative to be flexible, adaptable and carry a multitude of skills and responsibilities. He has a reputation for developing very strong teams by setting concise expectations, ensuring communication is clear and accurate, providing support, and treating everyone fairly and with dignity. For the last two decades he has specialized in the construction, expansion and problem solving required of mission critical facilities.
